label: invented example

columns_or_fields.name: FID
columns_or_fields.meaning: Family identifier, set equal to the invented sample identifier.

columns_or_fields.name: PAT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Father identifier, zero when not supplied.

columns_or_fields.name: MAT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Mother identifier, zero when not supplied.

columns_or_fields.name: allele pairs
columns_or_fields.meaning: Two columns per variant hold nucleotide alleles, with 0 0 for a missing call.

header_notes: The label is in the filename and this description when the format has no comment field.
Coordinates resemble GRCh38 but alleles and positions are invented, not reference-validated.
No header line is permitted in this example format.
